adventures.name: Bobcat
adventures.description: The first rank every Cub Scout earns. Learn the Scout Oath and Law, the Cub Scout sign, salute, and handshake, and the motto 'Do Your Best.'
prerequisites: None — Bobcat is the first rank a new Cub Scout earns
materials: How to Protect Your Children from Child Abuse: A Parent's Guide (for requirement 6)

requirements.text: Get to know the members of your den.

activities.name: Play a get-to-know-you game at your den meeting.
Introduce yourself to each Scout in your den and learn one thing about each of them.

requirements.text: Recite the Scout Oath with your den, including your Tiger adult partner.

activities.name: Practice reciting the Scout Oath together as a den.
Recite the Scout Oath with your Tiger adult partner.

requirements.text: Have your Tiger adult partner or den leader read the Scout Law to you. Demonstrate your understanding of being trustworthy, helpful, or friendly.

activities.name: Listen as the Scout Law is read, then talk about what 'trustworthy,' 'helpful,' or 'friendly' means.
Share a time you were trustworthy, helpful, or friendly.

requirements.text: Demonstrate the Cub Scout sign, Cub Scout salute and Cub Scout handshake. Show how each are used.

activities.name: Learn and practice the Cub Scout sign, salute, and handshake.
Show when each is used during a den meeting.

requirements.text: Share with your Tiger adult partner, at a den meeting or at home, a time when you have demonstrated the Cub Scout motto 'Do Your Best.'

activities.name: Tell your den or family about a time you did your best.
Share an example of 'Do Your Best' at home with your Tiger adult partner.

requirements.text: At home, with your parent or legal guardian do the activities in the booklet 'How to Protect Your Children from Child Abuse: A Parent's Guide.'

activities.name: Complete the activities in the parent's guide booklet at home with your parent or guardian.
Talk with your family about what you learned from the booklet.

adventures.name: Tiger Bites
adventures.description: Discover how eating right and being active helps you grow strong.

requirements.text: Talk about what happens when you don't eat right.

activities.name: Discuss how you feel when you eat junk food versus healthy food.
Make a list of healthy snacks.

requirements.text: Learn why fruits and vegetables are important.

activities.name: Taste test different fruits and vegetables.
Create a healthy plate using food groups.

requirements.text: Play a game that helps you learn about healthy eating.

activities.name: Play 'Healthy Foods Bingo.'
Make a fruit and vegetable crossword puzzle.

requirements.text: Show how you can be active every day.

activities.name: Demonstrate three ways to stay active.
Create a daily activity plan with your family.

adventures.name: Tiger's Roar
adventures.description: Use your voice and body to express yourself through stories, songs, and games.

requirements.text: Tell a story using your voice and actions.

activities.name: Practice telling a short story to your den.
Use different voices and gestures while storytelling.

requirements.text: Learn a song and perform it for your den or family.

activities.name: Learn a Tiger den song.
Sing the song at a pack meeting.

requirements.text: Play a game where you listen and respond to directions.

activities.name: Play a listening game like 'Simon Says.'
Practice following group directions quickly.

requirements.text: Talk about how you feel and why.

activities.name: Share how you felt about a recent activity.
Practice using words to describe emotions.

adventures.name: Tiger Circles
adventures.description: Explore the world around you through observation, experiments, and discovery.

requirements.text: Observe something in nature and describe what you see.

activities.name: Go on a nature walk and observe plants or animals.
Draw or write about what you observed.

requirements.text: Do a simple science experiment.

activities.name: Perform a simple experiment like baking soda and vinegar.
Discuss what happened and why.

requirements.text: Learn about one way technology helps people.

activities.name: Talk about a piece of technology your family uses.
Discuss how technology has changed over time.

adventures.name: Team Tiger
adventures.description: Work together with your den and family to accomplish goals and have fun.

requirements.text: Work as a team to complete a project.

activities.name: Build something together as a den.
Cooperate on a group art project.

requirements.text: Help someone in your den with a task.

activities.name: Assist a fellow Tiger with a skill.
Practice being a team player.

requirements.text: Play a game that requires teamwork.

activities.name: Play a team-building game like a relay race.
Work together to solve a puzzle.

requirements.text: Talk about what makes a good team member.

activities.name: Discuss qualities of a good team player.
Share examples of good teamwork from your den.

adventures.name: Tigers in the Wild
adventures.description: Learn about the world outside — animals, plants, and how to protect the environment.

requirements.text: Learn about three animals that live in the wild.

activities.name: Research three wild animals.
Draw or describe each animal and its habitat.

requirements.text: Visit a place in nature and observe it.

activities.name: Visit a park, zoo, or nature center.
Write or draw about your observations.

requirements.text: Learn how to protect plants and animals.

activities.name: Discuss ways to help the environment.
Create a simple plan to help protect nature.

requirements.text: Learn about one plant that grows in your area.

activities.name: Identify a local plant.
Learn about why it's important to the local ecosystem.

requirements.text: Talk about how you can help take care of the Earth.

activities.name: Share one way you can help the environment.
Create a personal 'help the Earth' pledge.

adventures.name: Champions for Nature
adventures.description: Learn how to protect the environment and care for plants, animals, and the world around you.

requirements.text: Learn about animals in your area and how to respect their homes.

activities.name: Talk about local animals and where they live.
Share how you can keep animal homes safe.

requirements.text: Learn how to reduce, reuse, and recycle.

activities.name: Sort items into reduce, reuse, and recycle.
Make something new from recycled materials.

requirements.text: Discover ways to save water and energy at home.

activities.name: Find ways your family can save water.
Learn how turning off lights saves energy.

requirements.text: Take part in an activity that helps nature.

activities.name: Plant a seed or care for a plant.
Pick up litter in your neighborhood.

adventures.name: Floats and Boats
adventures.description: Explore why things float and build your own simple boat.

requirements.text: Learn what makes things float or sink.

activities.name: Test different objects in water to see if they float or sink.
Talk about why some things float.

requirements.text: Build a simple boat that floats.

activities.name: Build a boat from foam or a milk carton.
Test your boat in a tub of water.

requirements.text: Learn about boats and people who use them.

activities.name: Name different kinds of boats.
Talk about how boats help people.

adventures.name: Good Knights
adventures.description: Use your imagination to become a knight and create a story of courage and kindness.

requirements.text: Learn what a knight is and what knights did.

activities.name: Hear a story about knights and castles.
Share one thing knights did long ago.

requirements.text: Create your own knight's shield or armor.

activities.name: Make a shield from cardboard.
Decorate a helmet or sword from paper towel rolls.

requirements.text: Demonstrate the qualities of a good knight.

activities.name: Show courage by trying something new.
Show kindness by helping someone.

adventures.name: Rolling Tigers
adventures.description: Learn how wheels and axles work by building a model car.

requirements.text: Learn how wheels and axles help things move.

activities.name: Look at how wheels are used on toys and vehicles.
Explain what an axle does.

requirements.text: Build a model car with wheels and an axle.

activities.name: Build a car body from a box or foam block.
Add bottle-cap wheels and test that they roll.

requirements.text: Race your car and talk about what made it go.

activities.name: Race your model car with your den.
Talk about what made the car roll well.

adventures.name: Sky is the Limit
adventures.description: Discover flight and space, and build your own flying toy.

requirements.text: Learn what makes things fly.

activities.name: Talk about birds, planes, and rockets.
Share what you think makes them fly.

requirements.text: Build and fly a simple flying toy.

activities.name: Make a paper airplane.
Build a straw-and-rubber-band launcher.

requirements.text: Learn about space and people who explore it.

activities.name: Name something you can see in the night sky.
Talk about what astronauts do.

adventures.name: Stories in Shapes
adventures.description: Create art using shapes and colors, and tell a story with your art.

requirements.text: Explore how artists use shapes and colors.

activities.name: Look at art and find the shapes in it.
Name the colors you see in artwork.

requirements.text: Create a picture using shapes.

activities.name: Cut and glue shapes into a picture.
Use shapes to make an animal or scene.

requirements.text: Tell a story about your art.

activities.name: Describe what your picture shows.
Tell the story behind your creation.

adventures.name: Tiger-iffic!
adventures.description: Get moving and discover how fun it is to be active and healthy.

requirements.text: Learn why being active keeps you healthy.

activities.name: Talk about why exercise is good for your body.
Share a fun way you like to be active.

requirements.text: Play an active game with your den.

activities.name: Play a running or movement game.
Do a stretching routine together.

requirements.text: Learn how your heart and body feel when active.

activities.name: Feel your heart beat faster after exercise.
Talk about how being active makes you feel.

adventures.name: Tiger Tag
adventures.description: Play active games with your den and learn how to have fun together.

requirements.text: Learn the rules of a game and play it.

activities.name: Learn a tag or chasing game.
Play the game with your den.

requirements.text: Create a game of your own.

activities.name: Invent a game with simple rules.
Teach your game to the den.

requirements.text: Learn about good sportsmanship.

activities.name: Practice taking turns and being fair.
Cheer for teammates and shake hands after the game.
